text:
sam: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from last week's GPU surge. Short list of owners/timelines please.
ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-gpu-surge (incidents/2234001234)
mira: TL;DR: we hit autoscaler floor, quota throttled, scheduler spilled pods. Need concrete owners for quota bump, scheduler tuning, and headroom plan.
sam: Agreed. Proposed action items (short):
1) Quota request (cloud quotas + internal reserve) — owner: ryan — due: 2026-03-30
2) Scheduler tuning (backoff + preemption knobs) — owner: jules — due: 2026-03-27
3) Headroom target & admission (static headroom + burst pool) — owner: kai — due: 2026-04-02
4) Autoscaler policy review (min/max, scale-down grace) — owner: sam — due: 2026-03-28
5) Incident-detection rule for repeated surge patterns — owner: sre-anne — due: 2026-03-31
I put all details in the tracking doc: https://notion.redwood/ops/gpu-capacity-remedials
jules: For scheduler tuning, propose this quick tweak to kube-scheduler config:
```
--max-pending-time=45s
--preemption-victims-per-node=1
--pod-eviction-rate=5
```
Also add fair-share weights for batch jobs.
kai: I'll draft the headroom calc. Current proposal: target 18-22% idle GPUs for peak windows, with a burst pool of 6 GPUs reserved for priority jobs. Question: do we treat Dedicated pools separately from Hosted?
ryan: I'll take quota. Filing cloud ticket today and internal reserve request. PR for the quota runbook here: https://git.redwood/infradev/ops/+/blob/quota-bump.md
sre-anne: For recurring pattern detection, I'll add a daily job that computes 7-day rolling surge frequency and alerts if >2 spikes. Also recommend an automated postmortem stub on repeat incidents.
sam: Great. Let's also make the scheduler change behind a canary toggle in Dedicated; jules please add rollout steps and rollback criteria.
jules: Will do. Rollout plan: canary 5% of hosts for 48h, metrics: scheduling latency, preemption count, PodCreationFailures.
mira: Can we get a quick owner standup tomorrow? 15 min to lock timelines.
sam: 10:30am UTC tomorrow — calendar invite sent. Please update the tracking doc before then.
ryan: Quota ticket filed: CLOUD-4987. Internal reserve request created: https://boards.redwood/requests/BR-334. ETA for cloud approval ~3 business days.
ryan: Assigned to me: I expect to close quota item by 2026-03-29. Will update thread.
sre-anne: FYI adding alert: "gpu.surge.recurrence" with threshold 3 spikes/week. Proto PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/+/pr/764
sam: Thanks everyone. Marking sam,mira,ryan,jules,kai,sre-anne in doc as primary watchers. We'll triage any blockers in tomorrow's standup. :thumbsup:
mira: Acknowledged. :eyes:
--- 48 hours later ---
ryan: Quick status update: quota approved by cloud vendor, reserve allocated. CLOUD-4987 closed. Updated the Notion doc.
jules: Scheduler canary started on 5% hosts — initial telemetry looks fine, PMC down to 120ms avg. Monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood/gpu-sched-canary
kai: Headroom calc v1 submitted to the doc. I'm suggesting a gradual ramp to 20% over two weeks.
sre-anne: Automated recurrence alert in staging. Will promote to prod after one week of validation.
sam: Nice. If no objections, we'll close items as they finish and keep the thread as the longitudinal log. :sparkles:
mira: Awesome work team. Closing loop on postmortem follow-ups for now.
